brief: The no-infrastructure backend stack: 6 serverless tools running $50K ARR businesses.

slots.tagline: The React framework for serverless APIs and frontend apps without infrastructure.
slots.f1Body: Build backend endpoints inside your frontend repo without any server setup.
slots.f2Body: Render pages on the edge without provisioning Node instances or load balancers.
slots.f3Body: Intercept requests globally for auth and A/B tests at the edge.

slots.tagline: Open-source Firebase alternative that gives you Postgres, auth, and edge functions without servers.
slots.f1Body: Store relational data on managed Postgres with automatic scaling and backups.
slots.f2Body: Secure data access per user directly inside the database without backend code.
slots.f3Body: Deploy serverless TypeScript functions globally with zero container management.

slots.tagline: Deploy frontend and serverless functions globally on a zero-configuration edge network.
slots.f1Body: Push to GitHub and watch preview and production deploy automatically in seconds.
slots.f2Body: Run API routes as pay-per-request functions without provisioning servers or VMs.
slots.f3Body: Cache and serve content from over one hundred edge nodes for minimal latency.

slots.tagline: Collect payments, manage subscriptions, and handle invoicing with only a few lines of code.
slots.f1Body: Charge customers monthly or annually without building your own billing ledger.
slots.f2Body: Listen to payment events to provision accounts and send emails instantly.
slots.f3Body: Redirect buyers to prebuilt hosted payment forms that convert and comply.

slots.tagline: Automate backend tasks and data flows visually without maintaining any cron servers.
slots.f1Body: Drag and drop nodes to replace thousands of lines of integration code.
slots.f2Body: Expose HTTP endpoints that trigger workflows from Stripe or form events.
slots.f3Body: Automate tasks on their cloud or a lightweight self-hosted container.

slots.tagline: Host code, run CI pipelines, and automate releases with GitHub Actions workflows.
slots.f1Body: Test and deploy your stack on every push with YAML workflow files.
slots.f2Body: Review changes safely before merging into production with protected branches.
slots.f3Body: Version every deploy so you can roll back serverless releases in seconds.

slots.ctaBody: This six-tool stack replaces an entire DevOps team. Run lean at any revenue stage.
